cards.target: Lorsque vous arriverez, appelez-moi.
cards.english: When you arrive, call me.

cards.target: Tu pourrais au moins t'excuser.
cards.english: You could at least apologize.

cards.target: Ça vaudrait le coup d'essayer.
cards.english: It would be worth trying.

cards.target: On devrait se retrouver plus souvent.
cards.english: We should meet up more often.

cards.target: Vous devriez goûter cette spécialité locale.
cards.english: You should try this local specialty.

cards.target: Quand tu seras grand, tu comprendras.
cards.english: When you grow up, you'll understand.

cards.target: Ce soir, je me coucherai tôt.
cards.english: Tonight, I'll go to bed early.

cards.target: Nous allons partir dans cinq minutes.
cards.english: We're going to leave in five minutes.

cards.target: Les travaux dureront environ trois mois.
cards.english: The work will last about three months.

cards.target: Je voulais qu'elle connût la réponse.
cards.english: I wanted her to know the answer.

cards.target: Les enfants grandiront vite, tu verras.
cards.english: The children will grow up fast, you'll see.

cards.target: L'homme qui parle est mon père.
cards.english: The man who is speaking is my father.

cards.target: Si j'étais toi, j'accepterais cette offre.
cards.english: If I were you, I would accept this offer.

cards.target: Il vaudrait mieux attendre les résultats.
cards.english: It would be better to wait for the results.

cards.target: Nous devrions commencer à planifier nos vacances.
cards.english: We should start planning our vacation.

cards.target: Il serait temps de prendre une décision.
cards.english: It would be time to make a decision.

cards.target: L'été prochain, il fera sûrement très chaud.
cards.english: Next summer, it will surely be very hot.

cards.target: Il n'y avait personne qui pût l'aider.
cards.english: There was no one who could help him.

cards.target: Elle va commencer un nouveau travail lundi.
cards.english: She's going to start a new job on Monday.

cards.target: Quand j'aurai terminé, je passerai te voir.
cards.english: When I'm done, I'll come by to see you.

cards.target: On va bientôt déjeuner, tu viens ?
cards.english: We're going to have lunch soon, are you coming?

cards.target: Elle cherchait un ami qui la comprît.
cards.english: She was looking for a friend who would understand her.

cards.target: On va avoir besoin de plus de temps.
cards.english: We're going to need more time.

cards.target: Les photos que nous avons prises sont superbes.
cards.english: The photos we took are superb.

cards.target: Tu vas voir, ce film est vraiment génial.
cards.english: You'll see, this movie is really great.

cards.target: Quand vous aurez lu ce livre, vous comprendrez.
cards.english: When you've read this book, you'll understand.

cards.target: Si j'avais le temps, je voyagerais plus souvent.
cards.english: If I had time, I would travel more often.

cards.target: Ce serait bien de partir en vacances ensemble.
cards.english: It would be nice to go on vacation together.

cards.target: Je vais m'inscrire à un cours de cuisine.
cards.english: I'm going to sign up for a cooking class.

cards.target: Je vais chercher les enfants à seize heures.
cards.english: I'm going to pick up the children at four o'clock.

cards.target: Nous allons installer une nouvelle cuisine cet été.
cards.english: We're going to install a new kitchen this summer.

cards.target: Il vaudrait mieux que tu consultes un spécialiste.
cards.english: It would be better for you to see a specialist.

cards.target: Si tu faisais du sport, tu te sentirais mieux.
cards.english: If you did sports, you would feel better.

cards.target: Ça me plairait de vivre dans un pays chaud.
cards.english: I would enjoy living in a warm country.

cards.target: Tu n'auras qu'à me passer un coup de fil.
cards.english: You'll just have to give me a call.

cards.target: La robe que tu portes te va très bien.
cards.english: The dress you're wearing looks great on you.

cards.target: Si nous avions un jardin, nous planterions des légumes.
cards.english: If we had a garden, we would plant vegetables.

cards.target: Elles vont prendre le bus pour aller au centre-ville.
cards.english: They're going to take the bus to go downtown.

cards.target: La réunion aura lieu dans la salle de conférence.
cards.english: The meeting will take place in the conference room.

cards.target: La mère souhaitait que son enfant dormît en paix.
cards.english: The mother wished her child would sleep in peace.

cards.target: La prochaine réunion se tiendra dans la grande salle.
cards.english: The next meeting will be held in the large room.

cards.target: Le temps se refroidira à partir de la semaine prochaine.
cards.english: The weather will cool down starting next week.

cards.target: Je vais te prêter mon livre quand je l'aurai fini.
cards.english: I'm going to lend you my book when I've finished it.

cards.target: Je vais profiter du beau temps pour faire une balade.
cards.english: I'm going to take advantage of the nice weather to go for a walk.

cards.target: Si les cours étaient en ligne, je gagnerais du temps de trajet.
cards.english: If classes were online, I would save commute time.

cards.target: Si elle avait le choix, elle vivrait au bord de la mer.
cards.english: If she had the choice, she would live by the sea.

cards.target: La recette que ma mère m'a transmise est un trésor de famille.
cards.english: The recipe my mother passed down to me is a family treasure.

cards.target: On pourrait peut-être trouver un accord.
cards.english: We could perhaps find an agreement.

cards.target: Nous passerons les fêtes en famille.
cards.english: We'll spend the holidays with family.

cards.target: J'adorerais visiter le Japon un jour.
cards.english: I would love to visit Japan someday.

cards.target: Le spectacle commencera à vingt heures.
cards.english: The show will start at 8 PM.

cards.target: On va devoir changer nos habitudes.
cards.english: We're going to have to change our habits.

cards.target: Je ne ferais jamais une chose pareille.
cards.english: I would never do such a thing.

cards.target: Tu viendras nous voir quand tu voudras.
cards.english: You'll come see us whenever you want.

cards.target: Nous vous informerons du changement de programme.
cards.english: We'll inform you of the schedule change.

cards.target: La navette partira toutes les trente minutes.
cards.english: The shuttle will depart every thirty minutes.

cards.target: Je te rejoindrai au café vers midi.
cards.english: I'll join you at the café around noon.

cards.target: La conférence commencera à neuf heures précises.
cards.english: The conference will start at exactly nine o'clock.

cards.target: Le plombier viendra réparer la fuite demain.
cards.english: The plumber will come to fix the leak tomorrow.

cards.target: Si j'avais ton talent, je deviendrais artiste.
cards.english: If I had your talent, I would become an artist.

existing_tips: "Qui" is used for subjects: le restaurant fait → le restaurant qui fait.
Imperfect subjunctive of avoir: eût. Literary equivalent of 'bien qu'il ait raison'.
After "dès que" and "quand," French uses the futur simple, unlike English.
"Que" replaces the direct object. In passé composé, the past participle agrees with "que" (masculine
'Il faudrait que' + subjunctive – conditional of 'falloir' for polite necessity: 'you should...'
'Je conduirais si je n'avais pas bu' = I would drive if I hadn't drunk. Conditional for unreal prese
"Finir par" + infinitive = to end up doing something. Finiras = futur simple of finir.
'Décollera' – futur simple for scheduled events (flights, trains). Common in announcements.
Avoir besoin de → dont: "la personne dont tu as besoin."
